caption: Diagram 6.1 Ceiling void and roof space (only applicable to rooms for residential purposes)
description: This section drawing, titled "Diagram 6.1 Ceiling void and roof space (only applicable to rooms for residential purposes)", illustrates a horizontal ceiling structure supported by vertical joists. The space above the joists is filled with clumps of material labeled "Mineral wool". A vertical rectangular column, representing a flue or chimney, runs up through the center of the ceiling, with the mineral wool packed around its upper section. A label pointing to the junction where the ceiling meets the central column reads "Ceiling not continuous between rooms, joints sealed with tape or flexible sealant", indicating a specific joint detail at that junction. The word "SECTION" is printed in the bottom right corner.
